
---
title: "Assignment 5 - Hierarchical Clustering"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)

data <- read.csv("Cereals.csv")
data <- na.omit(data)

numeric_data <- data %>% select_if(is.numeric)
scaled_data <- scale(numeric_data)

agnes_single <- agnes(scaled_data, method = "single")
agnes_complete <- agnes(scaled_data, method = "complete")
agnes_average <- agnes(scaled_data, method = "average")
agnes_ward <- agnes(scaled_data, method = "ward")

plot(agnes_single)
plot(agnes_complete)
plot(agnes_average)
plot(agnes_ward)

agnes_ward$ac

cluster_model <- cutree(agnes_ward, k = 4)
table(cluster_model)

set.seed(123)
n <- nrow(scaled_data)
idx <- sample(1:n, n/2)

A <- scaled_data[idx, ]
B <- scaled_data[-idx, ]

agnes_A <- agnes(A, method = "ward")
clusters_A <- cutree(agnes_A, k = 4)
centroids <- aggregate(A, by=list(cluster=clusters_A), mean)

assign_to_centroid <- function(df, centers){
  apply(df, 1, function(x){
    dists <- apply(centers[,-1], 1, function(c) sum((x-c)^2))
    which.min(dists)
  })
}

B_assigned <- assign_to_centroid(B, centroids)

agnes_full <- agnes(scaled_data, method = "ward")
full_clusters <- cutree(agnes_full, 4)
full_B <- full_clusters[-idx]

table(B_assigned, full_B)

healthy_cluster <- which.max(centroids$fiber)
healthy_cluster
```
